note: LAYER 2 — the hidden evaluation ground truth (ENG-008 §2). Authored from each task's own requirements, WITHOUT knowing which dataset record retrieval will select, and never by copying a record's acceptance_criteria or negative_prompt. Identical across arms A-F. Never enters a prompt in any arm, including repair prompts. Frozen and hashed before a run; a mid-run edit without a version bump discards that version's results. Assertions marked kind=human are not deterministically checkable and must be counted separately from automated ones — 'task success' means 'passed the structural checks', and reporting must say so.

assertions.value: (monthly|annual|month|year|monat|jahr)
Exactly one tier is visually distinguished from the other two.
Switching the billing period changes the displayed prices rather than only a label.

T001.notes: A static three-column layout with no working toggle fails a2 in substance even if the word appears.

assertions.value: type=["']?password
(type=["']?email|inputmode=["']?email)
An error message is rendered next to or below the field it concerns, not only at the form level.
A password reset link is present and distinct from the submit action.

T002.notes: forbidden targets a hardcoded credential in the source, not the word in a label. Checked case-insensitively against string literals only.

assertions.value: Sorting is per column and toggles direction on repeated activation.
The search filters across all columns, not only the first.
500 rows are handled without rendering all of them at once, or the tradeoff is stated.

T003.notes: a3 is deliberately satisfiable two ways: virtualise, or say plainly that it does not. An unstated full render fails.

assertions.value: (ondrop|onDrop|dragover|dragOver)
Progress is shown per file, not as a single aggregate bar.
An oversized file produces a visible rejection, not a silent drop.

T004.notes: Drag and drop must be handled, not merely mentioned in a comment.

assertions.value: Four distinct metric cards appear above the chart in the layout order.
The chart covers a 30-day range rather than an unspecified series.

T005.notes: Chart library choice is free. a3 concerns the range, not the library.

assertions.value: Cart line items are shown with quantities and a total.
A shipping address form is present.
At least two delivery options are selectable.

T006.notes: The request explicitly excludes payment. A payment step present is a scope failure, which is what forbidden encodes here.

assertions.value: role=["']?dialog|aria-modal
(Escape|Esc|keyCode ?=== ?27)
Focus is moved into the modal on open and restored to the trigger on close.
Tab cycles within the modal and cannot reach the page behind it.

T007.notes: a3 and a4 are the substance. a1 and a2 are cheap to satisfy and are not sufficient on their own.

assertions.value: Three distinct sections are present: profile, notifications, danger zone.
Account deletion requires an explicit confirmation step before it fires.
The danger zone is visually separated from the ordinary settings.

T008.notes: A confirm() call satisfies a2. So does a typed-confirmation dialog. A delete button that fires directly does not.
